article.title: Brent crude climbs to a five-month high on tightening OPEC+ supply
article.text: Brent crude settled at a five-month high after OPEC+ signalled it would hold production cuts through the next quarter, tightening global supply as demand stayed resilient.
article.note: HINDOILEXP shape, isolated: the mapping stage proposes a micro-cap explorer purely because its NAME and SECTOR resemble the real upstream-realization beneficiaries -- 'oil exploration' pattern-matches the mechanism prior even though the company's actual commercial output is negligible. The verifier ACCEPTS the candidate (it is a real company with a real, if thin, mechanism -- inclusion itself is not the defect) but answers the SEMANTIC COUNTERFACTUAL question NOT_SUPPORTED: the claim would survive the event's removal, i.e. it is a generic sector/name-pattern match rather than something this specific crude move causes. That verdict reaches the deterministic gate as COUNTERFACTUAL_VALID -> REJECT_NOT_EVENT_SPECIFIC, so the candidate is a REAL excluded row (tier D, a genuine decision record), not a candidate that silently never existed -- distinguishing 'caught' from 'never proposed', which a verifier-reject (popped pre-gate) cannot.

ground_truth.rationale: HINDOILEXP genuinely operates in the same sub-sector as the real upstream beneficiaries and the mapping stage's rationale reads plausibly on its face -- this is exactly what makes it a semantic-similarity false positive rather than an obviously bad candidate. The verifier ACCEPTS it (a real company, a real if thin mechanism) but answers NOT_SUPPORTED on the semantic counterfactual: this company's own commercial output is too small for a benchmark crude move to be a material, event-specific story about IT specifically, so the claim would survive the event's removal -- the definition of a generic sector/name-pattern match. That verdict reaches the deterministic gate (COUNTERFACTUAL_VALID -> REJECT_NOT_EVENT_SPECIFIC) rather than being popped pre-gate by a verifier-reject, so this fixture pins a REAL excluded decision record (tier D, evidence-tier assertable) -- distinguishing 'the safeguard caught it' from 'it was never proposed at all', which the archetype-eligibility machinery breaking or the mapping stage returning nothing would both also produce.
